texts/city-names.md.ipoh: The tin town of the Kinta valley, taken in the advance down the west coast in December 1941.
texts/city-names.md.amarapura: Royal capital from 1783 and again from 1842, until the court moved to Mandalay.
texts/city-names.md.kualalipis: The seat of Pahang from 1898 to 1955, a gold-mining centre before the British came, which grew when the railway reached it in 1924.
